name: Akantio POS
author: supportakantio

sections.description:
Akantio POS is a point-of-sale application. This plugin is the WooCommerce
side of the connection: it lets your Akantio POS register push completed
sales into this store, or keep stock levels in sync, without WooCommerce
recalculating any totals, taxes, or quantities POS already computed.

Two independent sync modes (choose one from Akantio POS itself):

  • Order Sync — every completed POS sale is created here as a real
    WooCommerce order, exactly as rung up, with stock reduced automatically.
  • Stock-only Sync — POS sales adjust product stock levels directly,
    without creating an order in WooCommerce.

Compatible with both High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and legacy
post-based order storage.

How the connection works

Connecting is driven entirely from Akantio POS, not from this site — open
Akantio POS and follow its “Connect to WooCommerce” flow, which authenticates
using WooCommerce’s own native REST API consumer key/secret system (the same
mechanism any other WooCommerce REST API client uses). This plugin does not
store, generate, or manage that credential itself.

Third-party service disclosure

This plugin does not make any outbound network requests to Akantio or any
other third party. All communication is inbound: your Akantio POS instance
calls this site’s REST API (authenticated via WooCommerce’s native REST
auth) to push orders or stock updates. The only exception is the “Open POS”
link in this plugin’s admin page, which — only when you click it — opens
Akantio POS in your browser, the same as clicking any bookmark.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce if you haven’t already.
  2. Upload and activate this plugin (Plugins → Add New, or upload the zip).
  3. Open Akantio POS and use its “Connect to WooCommerce” flow to link this
    store — no configuration is needed on the WordPress side.
  4. In Akantio POS, choose Order Sync or Stock-only Sync and confirm the
    connection succeeded from WooCommerce → Akantio POS in wp-admin, which
    shows a log of recent sync activity.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without Akantio POS?

No. This plugin only exposes the REST endpoints Akantio POS calls; it has
no functionality on its own without a connected POS instance.

Does this recalculate my order totals or taxes?

No. Orders and stock changes are applied exactly as Akantio POS computed
them at the register — this plugin deliberately never calls WooCommerce’s
own recalculation methods.

Is High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) supported?

Yes, as well as legacy post-based order storage.

Where do I manage the connection or see sync activity?

WooCommerce → Akantio POS in wp-admin shows recent order and stock sync
activity, with links to the affected orders/products, and a link to open
Akantio POS.
sections.changelog:
0.1.0

  • Order Sync: push completed POS sales into WooCommerce as real orders,
    with correct tax lines and automatic stock reduction, exactly as rung up.
  • Stock-only Sync: push POS stock changes into WooCommerce without creating
    orders.
  • Idempotent by design — safe to retry a push without creating duplicates.
  • Activity log (WooCommerce → Akantio POS) showing recent sync activity.
